description:
9th Annual Black Music Honors
Hosted by LeToya Luckett and DeRay Davis, the 8th Annual Black Music Honors celebrates Missy Elliott, SWV, Evelyn "Champagne" King, Jeffrey Osborne and The Hawkins Family for their significant contributions to African American music.
